undated_mentions: Joined the United States Navy after failing to find employment following graduation
Enrolled in the Navy Nuclear Power School
Served as a non-commissioned officer in the Navy Nuclear Power Program aboard an aircraft carrier
Deployed twice aboard the aircraft carrier
Worked at Cole-Parmer in Chicago, Illinois, then returned to Tennessee
Promoted from technician to research associate and program manager at ORNL
Alumna of the Tennessee Aquatic Project and Development Group
Involved in the discovery of tennessine (element 117)
Recognized by IUPAC as the first African-American woman involved in discovery of a chemical element
Featured on the ORAU STEM stories program
Diversity chair of ORNL Educational Outreach Committee for Knox County Schools
Established ASCEND robotics and coding program for Knoxville high school students
Vice President of the board of Youth Outreach in STEM (YO-STEM)
